name: Wankstüberl
kurzbeschreibung: No evidence of a Wankstüberl in Tyrol: all sources locate the establishment at Wankbahnstraße 2 in Garmisch-Partenkirchen (Bavaria, DE).
beschreibung:
Overview

Research on the “Wankstüberl” entry in the Tyrol tourism portal shows that a catering establishment of this name cannot be verified in Tyrol. All sources evaluated locate the Wankstüberl in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, in the Upper Bavarian district of Garmisch-Partenkirchen (Germany), at the address Wankbahnstraße 2, 82467 Garmisch-Partenkirchen. It is therefore located directly at the valley station of the Wankbahn. A location in North or East Tyrol (Austria) cannot be found in any source; consequently, the entry does not belong in the catering category of an Austrian regional portal.

History/Background

An independent, officially confirmed history of the establishment could not be determined. What is documented is the surrounding area: the Wank is a popular 1780-metre-high panoramic mountain in the Estergebirge near Garmisch-Partenkirchen and is accessible via the Wankbahn cable car. The Wankbahn valley station with a large car park is located on Wankbahnstraße; it is the starting point for hikes and mountain tours up the Wank. The Wankstüberl is located in this area. A restaurant database lists the establishment as “permanently closed” and cites a Google rating of 4.3 out of 29 reviews with a price range of around 10 to 20 euros per person. A menu platform, by contrast, lists the restaurant with 4.0 out of 5 from 49 reviews and daily hours from 10:00 to 17:00. These details come from unofficial third-party sources and contradict each other; official confirmation is lacking.

Getting there

Since the documented location lies outside Tyrol, no travel description can be given for a Tyrolean establishment. For the actual location in Bavaria, according to the hiking description evaluated: travel via the Munich–Garmisch motorway and the B 2 through Oberau and the Farchanter Tunnel to Partenkirchen, at the roundabout go straight ahead and after about one kilometre turn left towards the Wankbahn (signposted), then turn left into Wankbahnstraße; after about 500 metres, park on the right at the large Wankbahn car park. By public transport, the Munich–Garmisch railway line goes to Farchant, from there take bus lines 3 or 4 to the Wankbahn stop. These details refer to the mountain or the Wankbahn, not to a Tyrolean establishment.

Tips

For the Tyrol portal, this entry should not be published, because the documented location is in Germany. Anyone wishing to visit the place in Upper Bavaria will find it at Wankbahnstraße 2 in Garmisch-Partenkirchen. Due to the contradictory information about opening (one database reports the establishment as permanently closed, another cites daily hours), a current check is advisable before a visit. Reliable, officially confirmed telephone, email or website details of the establishment could not be determined and therefore remain blank.

Best time to travel

A reliable seasonal recommendation cannot be derived from the sources examined. In general, the region around Garmisch-Partenkirchen and the Wank is accessible both in summer for hiking and in winter for winter sports via the Wankbahn. There are no robust, officially confirmed season or opening times for the Wankstüberl; such details are therefore not given.
